name: Dragonstorm
description: A massive storm stirs in the skies above Breachill and Citadel Altaerein. As specific events begin during the three waves of the manifestation's retribution, the dragonstorm wreaks localized havoc.
disable: The dragonstorm can't be disabled-only endured. It ends only once the attack on Breachill and Citadel Altaerein is over.

generalAbilities.name: Localized Dragonstorm
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A new wave begins

Effect Roll 1d10 to determine which effect manifests from the following possibilities. The placement of these effects is guided by Dahak's will, and they should manifest in the most detrimental locations possible to the PCs.

generalAbilities.name: 1-2 Acid Rain
generalAbilities.description: A torrent of acid drenches creatures in a 20ft Burst. Creatures in the area take 6d10 Acid Damage damage (Basic DC 42 Reflex Saving Throw save). Creatures that critically fail also take 5 Persistent,acid Damage damage.

generalAbilities.name: 3-4 Freezing Wind
generalAbilities.description: A barrage of freezing wind and hail assaults all creatures in a 20ft Burst. Creatures in the area take 3d10 Cold Damage]{3d10 cold damage and 3d10 bludgeoning damage} (Basic DC 42 Reflex Saving Throw save). Creatures that critically fail are Slowed 1 for 1 round.

generalAbilities.name: 5-6 Bolts of Lightning
generalAbilities.description: Several bolts of lightning strike all creatures in a 20ft Burst. Creatures in the area take 6d10 Electricity Damage damage (Basic DC 42 Reflex Saving Throw save). Creatures that critically fail their saves become Blinded and Deafened for 1 round.

generalAbilities.name: 7-8 Flaming Vortex
generalAbilities.description: Gouts of flame fall on all creatures in a 20ft Burst. Creatures in the area take 6d10 Fire Damage damage (Basic DC 42 Reflex Saving Throw save). Creatures that critically fail their saves also take 5 Persistent,fire Damage damage.

generalAbilities.name: 9-10 Poison Miasma
generalAbilities.description: Poisonous mist rolls forth, covering a 20ft Burst for 1 round. Creatures within the mist become Concealed, and creatures outside it become concealed to creatures within it. Creatures within the mist take 6d10 Poison Damage damage (Basic DC 42 Fortitude Saving Throw save). Creatures that critically fail their saves become Enfeebled 2.
